commitResults.messageTitle: Added new task subtypes and testing

commitResults.messageBody:
Refactored Bob.java such that the UI, parsing, storage are in seperate
files

Task date and time is stored and displayed as a datetime object instead
of just a string

Standardize Javadocs across the Java source files to improve consistency
and clarify method contracts.

Rename containsTaskNumber to hasTaskNumber so the boolean method reads
naturally, and update its usages and tests accordingly.

Task lists cannot be filtered by a description keyword, which makes
finding a specific task difficult as the list grows.

Add a find command that matches descriptions without regard to case and
displays results in their original order. Cover command parsing, matching,
and console output with automated tests.

Integrate task keyword search after coding-standard changes.

Resolve overlapping edits while preserving both increments.

Add JavaFX dependencies and launch configuration, introduce the
graphical chat window, and decouple Bob's UI output for GUI display.
Fix dialog-box child ordering to prevent duplicate-node errors.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add internal assertions and fix JAR startup
commitResults.messageBody:
Document assumptions about command parsing, dispatch, and storage
schemas with assertions. Enable assertions in tests and verify that
invalid user input still receives normal error messages.

Add a separate launcher so the executable JAR can load its bundled
JavaFX runtime.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task construction from storage parsing
commitResults.messageBody:
Storage.parseTask mixes record validation, type-specific construction,
event-period parsing, and completion-state restoration. This makes the
persistence control flow harder to inspect when changing task formats.

Extract createTaskFromFields so parseTask reads as a short sequence of
record validation, task construction, and status restoration. Follow
the course guidance to avoid long methods and separate abstraction
levels while preserving validation order, file format, and behavior.

Add regression coverage for completed deadlines and events, malformed
field counts, and empty fields followed by a valid record.

Validation: all 39 JUnit tests pass on Java 25. The console UI runner
cannot compile because its classpath omits JavaFX dependencies; no UI
cases ran. The command transcripts are unchanged by this refactoring.

commitResults.messageTitle: Unify mark and unmark command handling
commitResults.messageBody:
The mark and unmark handlers duplicate task-number validation,
persistence, and feedback. Changes to this shared workflow must be
repeated in both places, which risks inconsistent behavior.

Extract updateTaskStatus and keep the named handlers as entry points.
Select usage text and the status mutation from the requested state,
then save and display feedback through one shared path. Preserve
validation messages, repeated-command behavior, and save-error handling.

Add regression tests for both commands covering selected-task updates,
persisted status, invalid arguments, repeated commands, and failed
saves. Correct the response-method documentation used by these tests.

Validation: all 42 JUnit tests pass on Java 25. The required console UI
runner cannot compile because it omits JavaFX dependencies, so no UI
cases ran. Existing mark/unmark transcripts require no changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract deadline argument parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody:
Bob.createDeadline mixes separator handling and argument validation
with persistence and user feedback. This makes parsing harder to test
independently and obscures the command coordination workflow.

Move deadline argument extraction and task construction into
Parser.parseDeadline. Keep usage and date-error reporting in Bob,
preserving accepted input, validation order, and existing messages.
Leave event parsing unchanged to keep this refactoring focused.

Add tests for dates and date-times, whitespace, missing arguments,
invalid dates, and repeated separators. All 45 JUnit tests pass on
Java 25. The UI runner remains blocked at compilation because its
classpath omits JavaFX dependencies; no UI cases ran.
Improve code quality through focused refactorings
Add assertions to document internal assumptions
